pages.text: An Orderstone is an Arcane Gem formed from a pink-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an oval cut.$(br2)When activated, an Orderstone transforms certain blocks into a more orderly state.$(br2)To recharge a dun Orderstone, collect experience globes while holding the gem.

pages.title: Transformations
pages.text: The following transformation sequences can be performed:$(br2)Sand -> Coarse Dirt -> Dirt -> Mycelium -> Podzol -> Grass Block$(br2)Gravel -> Cobblestone -> Stone$(br2)Mossy Cobblestone -> Cobblestone -> Stone

Cracked Stone Bricks -> Stone Bricks -> Chiseled Stone Bricks$(br2)Mossy Stone Bricks -> Stone Bricks -> Chiseled Stone Bricks$(br2)Damaged Anvil -> Slightly Damaged Anvil -> Anvil$(br2)Furnace -> Lit Furnace
$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:pink_dye$(br)1 × minecraft:anvil$(br)30 × minecraft:oak_sign$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:orderstone
